summary: @ornikar/lerna-config preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's `preinstall` script (setup.mjs) downloads the Bun runtime binary from GitHub releases (https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<arch>.zip), extracts the `bun` executable, and uses it to run a 727KB single-line, heavily obfuscated sibling file `math_init.js` via `execFileSync(bun, [math_init.js])`. Both setup.mjs and math_init.js use hex-mangled identifiers (`_0xNNNN`) and an array-rotation string decoder (`WV8StW` shifts a shuffled constant pool). The declared purpose of the package is a Lerna configuration helper, which has no legitimate need to fetch an alternate JavaScript runtime or to execute a large opaque payload at install time. The alternate-runtime dispatch is consistent with an evasion pattern designed to bypass Node-based install-time scanners: the malicious code never executes under Node, only under the freshly downloaded Bun binary. Any machine running `npm install` for this version executes attacker-controlled obfuscated code before the developer has a chance to inspect the package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
